verses.hebrew: אָדָם שֵׁת אֱנוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: Adam, Shet, Enosh,

verses.hebrew: קֵינָן מַהֲלַלְאֵל יָרֶד׃
verses.english: Qenan, Mahalal᾽el, Yered,

verses.hebrew: חֲנוֹךְ מְתוּשֶׁלַח לָמֶךְ׃
verses.english: Ḥanokh, Metushelaĥ, Lemekh,

verses.hebrew: נֹחַ שֵׁם חָם וָיָפֶת׃
verses.english: Noaĥ, Shem, Ḥam, and Yefet.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יֶפֶת גֹּמֶר וּמָגוֹג וּמָדַי וְיָוָן וְתֻבָל וּמֶשֶׁךְ וְתִירָס׃
verses.english: The sons of Yefet; Gomer, and Magog, and Maday, and Yavan, and Tuval, and Meshekh, and Tiras.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי גֹּמֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַז וְדִיפַת וְתוֹגַרְמָה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Gommer; Ashkenaz, and Difat, and Togarma.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יָוָן אֱלִישָׁה וְתַרְשִׁישָׁה כִּתִּים וְרוֹדָנִים׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yavan; Elisha, and Tarshisha, Kittim, and Rodanim.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי חָם כּוּשׁ וּמִצְרַיִם פּוּט וּכְנָעַן׃
verses.english: The sons of Ḥam; Kush, and Miżrayim, Put, and Kena῾an.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי כוּשׁ סְבָא וַחֲוִילָה וְסַבְתָּא וְרַעְמָא וְסַבְתְּכָא וּבְנֵי רַעְמָא שְׁבָא וּדְדָן׃
verses.english: And the sons of Kush; Seva, and Ḥavila, and Savta, and Ra῾ma, and Savtekha. And the sons of Ra῾ma; Sheva, and Dedan.

verses.hebrew: וְכוּשׁ יָלַד אֶת־נִמְרוֹד הוּא הֵחֵל לִהְיוֹת גִּבּוֹר בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And Kush begot Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

verses.hebrew: וּמִצְרַיִם יָלַד אֶת־לודיים [לוּדִים] וְאֶת־עֲנָמִים וְאֶת־לְהָבִים וְאֶת־נַפְתֻּחִים׃
verses.english: And Miżrayim begot Ludim, and ῾Anamim, and Lehavim, and Naftuĥim,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־פַּתְרֻסִים וְאֶת־כַּסְלֻחִים אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מִשָּׁם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְאֶת־כַּפְתֹּרִים׃
verses.english: and Patrusim, and Kasluĥim, (of whom came to the Pelishtim,) and Kaftorim.

verses.hebrew: וּכְנַעַן יָלַד אֶת־צִידוֹן בְּכֹרוֹ וְאֶת־חֵת׃
verses.english: And Kena῾an begot Żidon his firstborn, and Ḥet,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי וְאֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֵת הַגִּרְגָּשִׁי׃
verses.english: and the Yevusi, and the Emori, and the Girgashi,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַחִוִּי וְאֶת־הַעַרְקִי וְאֶת־הַסִּינִי׃
verses.english: and the Ḥivvi and the Arqi, and the Sini,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָאַרְוָדִי וְאֶת־הַצְּמָרִי וְאֶת־הַחֲמָתִי׃
verses.english: and the Arvadi, and the Żemari, and the Ḥamati.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שֵׁם עֵילָם וְאַשּׁוּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד וְלוּד וַאֲרָם וְעוּץ וְחוּל וְגֶתֶר וָמֶשֶׁךְ׃
verses.english: The sons of Shem; ῾Elam, and Ashshur, and Arpakhshad, and Lud, and Aram, and ῾Uż, and Ḥul, and Geter, and Meshekh.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד יָלַד אֶת־שָׁלַח וְשֶׁלַח יָלַד אֶת־עֵבֶר׃
verses.english: And Arpakhshad begot Shelaĥ, and Shelaĥ begot ῾Ever.

verses.hebrew: וּלְעֵבֶר יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים שֵׁם הָאֶחָד פֶּלֶג כִּי בְיָמָיו נִפְלְגָה הָאָרֶץ וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יָקְטָן׃
verses.english: And to ῾Ever were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Yoqtan.

verses.hebrew: וְיָקְטָן יָלַד אֶת־אַלְמוֹדָד וְאֶת־שָׁלֶף וְאֶת־חֲצַרְמָוֶת וְאֶת־יָרַח׃
verses.english: And Yoqtan begot Almodad, and Shelef, and Ḥażarmavet, and Yeraĥ,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הֲדוֹרָם וְאֶת־אוּזָל וְאֶת־דִּקְלָה׃
verses.english: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diqla,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עֵיבָל וְאֶת־אֲבִימָאֵל וְאֶת־שְׁבָא׃
verses.english: and ῾Eval, and Avima᾽el, and Sheva,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אוֹפִיר וְאֶת־חֲוִילָה וְאֶת־יוֹבָב כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יָקְטָן׃
verses.english: and Ofir, and Ḥavila, and Yovav. All these were the sons of Yoqtan.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁם אַרְפַּכְשַׁד שָׁלַח׃
verses.english: Shem, Arpakhshad, Shelaĥ,

verses.hebrew: עֵבֶר פֶּלֶג רְעוּ׃
verses.english: ῾Ever, Peleg, Re῾u,

verses.hebrew: שְׂרוּג נָחוֹר תָּרַח׃
verses.english: Serug, Naĥor, Teraĥ,

verses.hebrew: אַבְרָם הוּא אַבְרָהָם׃
verses.english: Avram; the same is Avraham.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל׃
verses.english: The sons of Avraham; Yiżĥaq, and Yishma᾽el.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹתָם בְּכוֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְבָיוֹת וְקֵדָר וְאַדְבְּאֵל וּמִבְשָׂם׃
verses.english: These are their generations: The firstborn of Yishma᾽el, Nevayot; then Qedar, and Adbe᾽el, and Mivsam,

verses.hebrew: מִשְׁמָע וְדוּמָה מַשָּׂא חֲדַד וְתֵימָא׃
verses.english: Mishma, and Duma, Massa, Ḥadad, and Tema,

verses.hebrew: יְטוּר נָפִישׁ וָקֵדְמָה אֵלֶּה הֵם בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל׃
verses.english: Yetur, Nafish, and Qedema. These are the sons of Yishma᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קְטוּרָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אַבְרָהָם יָלְדָה אֶת־זִמְרָן וְיָקְשָׁן וּמְדָן וּמִדְיָן וְיִשְׁבָּק וְשׁוּחַ וּבְנֵי יָקְשָׁן שְׁבָא וּדְדָן׃
verses.english: Now the sons of Qetura, Avraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, and Yoqshan, and Medan, and Midyan, and Yishbaq, and Shuaĥ. And the sons of Yoqshan; Sheva, and Dedan.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מִדְיָן עֵיפָה וָעֵפֶר וַחֲנוֹךְ וַאֲבִידָע וְאֶלְדָּעָה כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי קְטוּרָה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Midyan; ῾Efa, and ῾Efer, and Ḥanokh, and Avida, and Elda῾a. All these are the sons of Qetura.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹלֶד אַבְרָהָם אֶת־יִצְחָק בְּנֵי יִצְחָק עֵשָׂו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And Avraham begot Yiżĥaq. The sons of Yiżĥaq; ῾Esav and Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֱלִיפַז רְעוּאֵל וִיעוּשׁ וְיַעְלָם וְקֹרַח׃
verses.english: The sons of ῾Esav; Elifaz, Re῾u᾽el, and Ye῾ush, and Ya῾lam, and Qoraĥ.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אֱלִיפָז תֵּימָן וְאוֹמָר צְפִי וְגַעְתָּם קְנַז וְתִמְנָע וַעֲמָלֵק׃
verses.english: The sons of Elifaz; Teman, and Omar, Żefi, and Ga῾tam, Qenaz, and Timna, and ῾Amaleq.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל נַחַת זֶרַח שַׁמָּה וּמִזָּה׃
verses.english: The sons of Re῾u᾽el; Naĥat, Zeraĥ, Shamma, and Mizza.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שֵׂעִיר לוֹטָן וְשׁוֹבָל וְצִבְעוֹן וַעֲנָה וְדִישֹׁן וְאֵצֶר וְדִישָׁן׃
verses.english: And the sons of Se῾ir; Lotan, and Shoval, and Żiv῾on, and ῾Ana, and Dishon, and Eżer, and Dishan.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהוֹמָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע׃
verses.english: And the sons of Lotan; Ḥori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְיָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפִי וְאוֹנָם וּבְנֵי צִבְעוֹן אַיָּה וַעֲנָה׃
verses.english: The sons of Shoval; ῾Alyan, and Manaĥat, and ῾Eval, Shefi, and Onam. And the sons of Żiv῾on; Ayya, and ῾Ana.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עֲנָה דִּישׁוֹן וּבְנֵי דִישׁוֹן חַמְרָן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָן׃
verses.english: The sons of ῾Ana; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Ḥamran, and Eshban, and Yitran, and Keran.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־אֵצֶר בִּלְהָן וְזַעֲוָן יַעֲקָן בְּנֵי דִישׁוֹן עוּץ וַאֲרָן׃
verses.english: The sons of Eżer; Bilhan, and Za῾avan, and Ya῾aqan. The sons of Dishan; ῾Uż, and Aran.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לִפְנֵי מְלָךְ־מֶלֶךְ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּלַע בֶּן־בְּעוֹר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ דִּנְהָבָה׃
verses.english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Yisra᾽el; Bela the son of Be῾or: and the name of his city was Dinhava.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן־זֶרַח מִבָּצְרָה׃
verses.english: And when Bela was dead, Yovav the son of Zeraĥ of Bożra reigned in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חוּשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִי׃
verses.english: And when Yovav was dead, Ḥusham of the land of the Temani reigned in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת חוּשָׁם וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד בֶּן־בְּדַד הַמַּכֶּה אֶת־מִדְיָן בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ עיות [עֲוִית׃]
verses.english: And when Ḥusham was dead, Ḥadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midyan in the field of Mo᾽av, reigned in his place: and the name of his city was ῾Avit.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָה׃
verses.english: And when Ḥadad was dead, Samla of Masreqa reigned in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָר׃
verses.english: And when Samla was dead, Sha᾽ul of Reĥovot by the river reigned in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן־עַכְבּוֹר׃
verses.english: And when Sha᾽ul was dead, Ba῾al-ĥanan the son of Akhbor reigned in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת בַּעַל חָנָן וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ פָּעִי וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל בַּת־מַטְרֵד בַּת מֵי זָהָב׃
verses.english: And when Ba῾al-ĥanan was dead, Ḥadad reigned in his place: and the name of his city was Pa῾i; and his wife’s name was Mehetav᾽el, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahav.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת הֲדָד וַיִּהְיוּ אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם אַלּוּף תִּמְנָע אַלּוּף עליה [עַלְוָה] אַלּוּף יְתֵת׃
verses.english: Ḥadad died also. And the chiefs of Edom were; chief Timna, chief ῾Alva, chief Yetet,

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף אָהֳלִיבָמָה אַלּוּף אֵלָה אַלּוּף פִּינֹן׃
verses.english: chief Oholivama, chief Ela, chief Pinon,

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף קְנַז אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף מִבְצָר׃
verses.english: chief Qenaz, chief Teman, chief Mivżar,

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף מַגְדִּיאֵל אַלּוּף עִירָם אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: chief Magdi᾽el, chief ῾Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רְאוּבֵן שִׁמְעוֹן לֵוִי וִיהוּדָה יִשָׂשכָר וּזְבֻלוּן׃
verses.english: These are the sons of Yisra᾽el; Re᾽uven, Shim῾on, Levi, and Yehuda, Yissa­khar, and Zevulun,

verses.hebrew: דָּן יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן נַפְתָּלִי גָּד וְאָשֵׁר׃
verses.english: Dan, Yosef, and Binyamin, Naftali, Gad and Asher.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וְשֵׁלָה שְׁלוֹשָׁה נוֹלַד לוֹ מִבַּת־שׁוּעַ הַכְּנַעֲנִית וַיְהִי עֵר בְּכוֹר יְהוּדָה רַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיְמִיתֵהוּ׃
verses.english: The sons of Yehuda; ῾Er, and Onan, and Shela: which three were born to him of the daughter of Shua the Kena῾anite woman. And ῾Er, the firstborn of Yehuda, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.

verses.hebrew: וְתָמָר כַּלָּתוֹ יָלְדָה לּוֹ אֶת־פֶּרֶץ וְאֶת־זָרַח כָּל־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה חֲמִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pereż and Zeraĥ. All the sons of Yehuda were five.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־פֶרֶץ חֶצְרוֹן וְחָמוּל׃
verses.english: The sons of Pereż; Ḥeżron, and Ḥamul.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי זֶרַח זִמְרִי וְאֵיתָן וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וָדָרַע כֻּלָּם חֲמִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Zeraĥ; Zimri, and Etan, and Heman, and Kalkol, and Dare: five of them in all.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי כַּרְמִי עָכָר עוֹכֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר מָעַל בַּחֵרֶם׃
verses.english: And the sons of Karmi; ῾Akhar, the troubler of Yisra᾽el, who transgressed in the devoted property.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֵיתָן עֲזַרְיָה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Etan; ῾Azarya.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי חֶצְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר נוֹלַד־לוֹ אֶת־יְרַחְמְאֵל וְאֶת־רָם וְאֶת־כְּלוּבָי׃
verses.english: And the sons of Ḥeżron, that were born to him; Yeraĥme᾽el, and Ram, and Keluvay.

verses.hebrew: וְרָם הוֹלִיד אֶת־עַמִּינָדָב וְעַמִּינָדָב הוֹלִיד אֶת־נַחְשׁוֹן נְשִׂיא בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: And Ram begot ῾Amminadav; and ῾Amminadav begot Naĥshon, prince of the children of Yehuda;

verses.hebrew: וְנַחְשׁוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת־שַׂלְמָא וְשַׂלְמָא הוֹלִיד אֶת־בֹּעַז׃
verses.english: and Naĥshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Bo῾az,

verses.hebrew: וּבֹעַז הוֹלִיד אֶת־עוֹבֵד וְעוֹבֵד הוֹלִיד אֶת־יִשָׁי׃
verses.english: and Bo῾az begot ῾Oved, and ῾Oved begot Yishay,

verses.hebrew: וְאִישַׁי הוֹלִיד אֶת־בְּכֹרוֹ אֶת־אֱלִיאָב וַאֲבִינָדָב הַשֵּׁנִי וְשִׁמְעָא הַשְּׁלִישִׁי׃
verses.english: and Ishay begot his firstborn Eli᾽av, and Avinadav the second, and Shim῾a the third,

verses.hebrew: נְתַנְאֵל הָרְבִיעִי רַדַּי הַחֲמִישִׁי׃
verses.english: Netan᾽el the fourth, Radday the fifth,

verses.hebrew: אֹצֶם הַשִּׁשִּׁי דָּוִיד הַשְּׁבִעִי׃
verses.english: Ożem the sixth, David the seventh:

verses.hebrew: ואחיתיהם [וְאַחְיוֹתֵיהֶם] צְרוּיָה וַאֲבִיגָיִל וּבְנֵי צְרוּיָה אַבְשַׁי וְיוֹאָב וַעֲשָׂה־אֵל שְׁלֹשָׁה׃
verses.english: whose sisters were Żeruya, and Avigayil. And the sons of Żeruya; Avshay, and Yo᾽av, and Asa᾽el; three.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִיגַיִל יָלְדָה אֶת־עֲמָשָׂא וַאֲבִי עֲמָשָׂא יֶתֶר הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִי׃
verses.english: And Avigayil bore ῾Amasa: and the father of ῾Amasa was Yeter the Yishme῾elite.

verses.hebrew: וְכָלֵב בֶּן־חֶצְרוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזוּבָה אִשָּׁה וְאֶת־יְרִיעוֹת וְאֵלֶּה בָנֶיהָ יֵשֶׁר וְשׁוֹבָב וְאַרְדּוֹן׃
verses.english: And Kalev the son of Ḥeżron, begot children by ῾Azuva his wife, and by Yeri῾ot: her sons are these; Yesher, and Shovav, and Ardon.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּמָת עֲזוּבָה וַיִּקַּח־לוֹ כָלֵב אֶת־אֶפְרָת וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת־חוּר׃
verses.english: And when ῾Azuva was dead, Kalev took to him Efrat, who bore him Ḥur.

verses.hebrew: וְחוּר הוֹלִיד אֶת־אוּרִי וְאוּרִי הוֹלִיד אֶת־בְּצַלְאֵל׃
verses.english: And Ḥur begot Uri, and Uri begot Beżal᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר בָּא חֶצְרוֹן אֶל־בַּת־מָכִיר אֲבִי גִלְעָד וְהוּא לְקָחָהּ וְהוּא בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת־שְׂגוּב׃
verses.english: And afterwards Ḥeżron went in to the daughter of Makhir the father of Gil῾ad, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Seguv.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׂגוּב הוֹלִיד אֶת־יָאִיר וַיְהִי־לוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ עָרִים בְּאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: And Seguv begot Ya᾽ir, who had twenty three cities in the land of Gil῾ad.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח גְּשׁוּר־וַאֲרָם אֶת־חַוֺּת יָאִיר מֵאִתָּם אֶת־קְנָת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ שִׁשִּׁים עִיר כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי מָכִיר אֲבִי־גִלְעָד׃
verses.english: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with Ḥavvot-ya᾽ir, from them, with Qenat, and its hamlets, sixty cities. All these belonged to the sons of Makhir the father of Gil῾ad.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר מוֹת־חֶצְרוֹן בְּכָלֵב אֶפְרָתָה וְאֵשֶׁת חֶצְרוֹן אֲבִיָּה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת־אַשְׁחוּר אֲבִי תְקוֹעַ׃
verses.english: And after Ḥeżron had died in Kalev-efrata, then Aviyya, Ḥeżron’s wife bore him Ashĥur the father of Teqoa.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יְרַחְמְאֵל בְּכוֹר חֶצְרוֹן הַבְּכוֹר רָם וּבוּנָה וָאֹרֶן וָאֹצֶם אֲחִיָּה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yeraĥme᾽el the firstborn of Ḥeżron were, Ram the firstborn, and Buna, and Oren, and Ożem, and Aĥiyya.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי אִשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת לִירַחְמְאֵל וּשְׁמָהּ עֲטָרָה הִיא אֵם אוֹנָם׃
verses.english: Yeraĥme᾽el had also another wife, whose name was ῾Atara; she was the mother of Onam.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־רָם בְּכוֹר יְרַחְמְאֵל מַעַץ וְיָמִין וָעֵקֶר׃
verses.english: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Yeraĥme᾽el were, Ma῾aż, and Yamin, and E῾qer.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־אוֹנָם שַׁמַּי וְיָדָע וּבְנֵי שַׁמַּי נָדָב וַאֲבִישׁוּר׃
verses.english: And the sons of Onam were, Shammay, and Yada. And the sons of Shammay; Nadav, and Avishur.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת אֲבִישׁוּר אֲבִיהָיִל וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת־אַחְבָּן וְאֶת־מוֹלִיד׃
verses.english: And the name of the wife of Avishur was Aviĥayil, and she bore him Aĥban, and Molid.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי נָדָב סֶלֶד וְאַפָּיִם וַיָּמָת סֶלֶד לֹא בָנִים׃
verses.english: And the sons of Nadav; Seled, and Appayim; but Seled died without children.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אַפַּיִם יִשְׁעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׁעִי שֵׁשָׁן וּבְנֵי שֵׁשָׁן אַחְלָי׃
verses.english: And the sons of Appayim; Yish῾i, And the sons of Yish῾i; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Aĥlay.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יָדָע אֲחִי שַׁמַּי יֶתֶר וְיוֹנָתָן וַיָּמָת יֶתֶר לֹא בָנִים׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yada the brother of Shammay; Yeter, and Yonatan: and Yeter died without children.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יוֹנָתָן פֶּלֶת וְזָזָא אֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי יְרַחְמְאֵל׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yonatan; Pelet, and Zaza. These were the sons of Yeraĥme᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הָיָה לְשֵׁשָׁן בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וּלְשֵׁשָׁן עֶבֶד מִצְרִי וּשְׁמוֹ יַרְחָע׃
verses.english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had a slave, a Miżrian, whose name was Yarĥa.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן שֵׁשָׁן אֶת־בִּתּוֹ לְיַרְחָע עַבְדּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת־עַתָּי׃
verses.english: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Yarĥa his slave to wife; and she bore him ῾Attay.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתַּי הֹלִיד אֶת־נָתָן וְנָתָן הוֹלִיד אֶת־זָבָד׃
verses.english: And ῾Attay begot Natan, and Natan begot Zavad.

verses.hebrew: וְזָבָד הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֶפְלָל וְאֶפְלָל הוֹלִיד אֶת־עוֹבֵד׃
verses.english: and Zavad begot Eflal, and Eflal begot ῾Oved,

verses.hebrew: וְעוֹבֵד הוֹלִיד אֶת־יֵהוּא וְיֵהוּא הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה׃
verses.english: and ῾Oved begot Yehu, and Yehu begot ῾Azarya,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲזַרְיָה הֹלִיד אֶת־חָלֶץ וְחֶלֶץ הֹלִיד אֶת־אֶלְעָשָׂה׃
verses.english: and ῾Azarya begot Ḥeleż, and Ḥeleż begot El῾asa,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְעָשָׂה הֹלִיד אֶת־סִסְמָי וְסִסְמַי הֹלִיד אֶת־שַׁלּוּם׃
verses.english: and El῾asa begot Sismay, and Sismay begot Shallum,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁלּוּם הוֹלִיד אֶת־יְקַמְיָה וִיקַמְיָה הֹלִיד אֶת־אֱלִישָׁמָע׃
verses.english: and Shallum begot Yeqamya, and Yeqamya begot Elishama.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי כָלֵב אֲחִי יְרַחְמְאֵל מֵישָׁע בְּכֹרוֹ הוּא אֲבִי־זִיף וּבְנֵי מָרֵשָׁה אֲבִי חֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Now the sons of Kalev the brother of Yeraĥme᾽el were, Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Zif; and the sons of Maresha the father of Ḥevron.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי חֶבְרוֹן קֹרַח וְתַפֻּחַ וְרֶקֶם וָשָׁמַע׃
verses.english: And the sons of Ḥevron; Qoraĥ, and Tappuaĥ, and Reqem, and Shema.

verses.hebrew: וְשֶׁמַע הוֹלִיד אֶת־רַחַם אֲבִי יָרְקֳעָם וְרֶקֶם הוֹלִיד אֶת־שַׁמָּי׃
verses.english: And Shema begot Raĥam, the father of Yorqe῾am: and Reqem begot Shammay.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־שַׁמַּי מָעוֹן וּמָעוֹן אֲבִי בֵית־צוּר׃
verses.english: And the son of Shammay was Ma῾on: and Ma῾on was the father of Bet-żur.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵיפָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ כָּלֵב יָלְדָה אֶת־חָרָן וְאֶת־מוֹצָא וְאֶת־גָּזֵז וְחָרָן הֹלִיד אֶת־גָּזֵז׃
verses.english: And ῾Efa, Kalev’s concubine, bore Ḥaran, and Moża, and Gazez: and Ḥaran begot Gazez.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יָהְדָּי רֶגֶם וְיוֹתָם וְגֵישָׁן וָפֶלֶט וְעֵיפָה וָשָׁעַף׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yohday; Regem, and Yotam, and Geshan, and Pelet, and ῾Efa, and Sha῾af.

verses.hebrew: פִּלֶגֶשׁ כָּלֵב מַעֲכָה יָלַד שֶׁבֶר וְאֶת־תִּרְחֲנָה׃
verses.english: Ma῾akha, Kalev’s concubine, bore Shever, and Tirĥana.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד שַׁעַף אֲבִי מַדְמַנָּה אֶת־שְׁוָא אֲבִי מַכְבֵּנָה וַאֲבִי גִבְעָא וּבַת־כָּלֵב עַכְסָה׃
verses.english: She bore also Sha῾af the father of Madmanna, Sheva the father of Makhbena, and the father of Giv῾a: and the daughter of Kalev was ῾Akhsa.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי כָלֵב בֶּן־חוּר בְּכוֹר אֶפְרָתָה שׁוֹבָל אֲבִי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃
verses.english: These were the sons of Kalev the son of Ḥur, the firstborn of Efrata; Shoval the father of Qiryat-ye῾arim,

verses.hebrew: שַׂלְמָא אֲבִי בֵית־לָחֶם חָרֵף אֲבִי בֵית־גָּדֵר׃
verses.english: Salma the father of Bet-leĥem, Ḥaref the father of Bet-gader.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בָנִים לְשׁוֹבָל אֲבִי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים הָרֹאֶה חֲצִי הַמְּנֻחוֹת׃
verses.english: And Shoval the father of Qiryat-ye῾arim had sons; Haro᾽e, and half of the Menuĥot.

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת קִרְיַת יְעָרִים הַיִּתְרִי וְהַפּוּתִי וְהַשֻּׁמָתִי וְהַמִּשְׁרָעִי מֵאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ הַצָּרְעָתִי וְהָאֶשְׁתָּאֻלִי׃
verses.english: And the families of Qiryat-ye῾arim; the Yitri, and the Puti, and the Shumati, and the Mishra῾i; of them came the Żor῾ati, and the Eshta᾽uli.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שַׂלְמָא בֵּית לֶחֶם וּנְטוֹפָתִי עַטְרוֹת בֵּית יוֹאָב וַחֲצִי הַמָּנַחְתִּי הַצָּרְעִי׃
verses.english: The sons of Salma; Bet-leĥem, and the Netofati, ῾Atrot-bet-yo᾽av, and half the Manaĥti, and the Żor’i.

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת סֹפְרִים ישבו [יֹשְׁבֵי] יַעְבֵּץ תִּרְעָתִים שִׁמְעָתִים שׂוּכָתִים הֵמָּה הַקִּינִים הַבָּאִים מֵחַמַּת אֲבִי בֵית־רֵכָב׃
verses.english: And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Ya῾beż; the Tir῾atim, the Shim῾atim, the Sukhatim. These are the Qinim who came of Ḥamat, the father of the house of Rekhav.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי דָויִד אֲשֶׁר נוֹלַד־לוֹ בְּחֶבְרוֹן הַבְּכוֹר אַמְנֹן לַאֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִית שֵׁנִי דָּנִיֵּאל לַאֲבִיגַיִל הַכַּרְמְלִית׃
verses.english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Ḥevron; the firstborn Amnon, of Aĥino῾am the Yizre῾elite woman; Daniyyel of Avigayil the Karmelite woman:

verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁלִשִׁי לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־מַעֲכָה בַּת־תַּלְמַי מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר הָרְבִיעִי אֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית׃
verses.english: the third, Avshalom the son of Ma῾akha the daughter of Talmay king of Geshur: the fourth, Adoniyya the son of Ḥaggit:

verses.hebrew: הַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה לַאֲבִיטָל הַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃
verses.english: the fifth, Shefatya of Avital: the sixth, Yitre῾am by ῾Egla his wife.

verses.hebrew: שִׁשָּׁה נוֹלַד־לוֹ בְחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּמְלָךְ־שָׁם שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: These six were born to him in Ḥevron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Yerushalayim he reigned thirty three years.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם שִׁמְעָא וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹה אַרְבָּעָה לְבַת־שׁוּעַ בַּת־עַמִּיאֵל׃
verses.english: And these were born to him in Yerushalayim; Shim῾a, and Shovav, and Natan, and Shelomo; four, of Bat-Shua the daughter of Ammi᾽el:

verses.hebrew: וְיִבְחָר וֶאֱלִישָׁמָע וֶאֱלִיפָלֶט׃
verses.english: and Yivĥar, and Elishama, and Elifelet,

verses.hebrew: וְנֹגַהּ וְנֶפֶג וְיָפִיעַ׃
verses.english: and Noga, and Nefeg, and Yafia,

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָע וְאֶלְיָדָע וֶאֱלִיפֶלֶט תִּשְׁעָה׃
verses.english: and Elishama, and Elyada, and Elifelet; nine.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל בְּנֵי דָוִיד מִלְּבַד בְּנֵי־פִילַגְשִׁים וְתָמָר אֲחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־שְׁלֹמֹה רְחַבְעָם אֲבִיָּה בְנוֹ אָסָא בְנוֹ יְהוֹשָׁפָט בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: And Shelomo’s son was Reĥav῾am, Aviyya his son, Asa his son, Yehoshafat his son,

verses.hebrew: יוֹרָם בְּנוֹ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְנוֹ יוֹאָשׁ בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Yoram his son, Aĥazyahu his son, Yo᾽ash his son,

verses.hebrew: אֲמַצְיָהוּ בְנוֹ עֲזַרְיָה בְנוֹ יוֹתָם בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Amażyahu his son, ῾Azarya his son, Yotam his son,

verses.hebrew: אָחָז בְּנוֹ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Aĥaz his son, Ḥizqiyyahu his son, Menashshe his son,

verses.hebrew: אָמוֹן בְּנוֹ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Amon his son, Yoshiyyahu his son.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ הַבְּכוֹר יוֹחָנָן הַשֵּׁנִי יְהוֹיָקִים הַשְּׁלִשִׁי צִדְקִיָּהוּ הָרְבִיעִי שַׁלּוּם׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yoshiyyahu were, the firstborn Yoĥanan, the second Yehoyaqim, the third Żidqiyyahu, the fourth Shallum.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יְהוֹיָקִים יְכָנְיָה בְנוֹ צִדְקִיָּה בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yehoyaqim: Yekhonya his son, Żidqiyya his son.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יְכָנְיָה אַסִּר שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yekhonya; Assir, She᾽alti᾽el his son.

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְכִּירָם וּפְדָיָה וְשֶׁנְאַצַּר יְקַמְיָה הוֹשָׁמָע וּנְדַבְיָה׃
verses.english: and Malkiram, and Pedaya, and Shen᾽ażar, Yeqamya, Hoshama, and Nedavya.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי פְדָיָה זְרֻבָּבֶל וְשִׁמְעִי וּבֶן־זְרֻבָּבֶל מְשֻׁלָּם וַחֲנַנְיָה וּשְׁלֹמִית אֲחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: And the sons of Padaya were, Zerubbavel, and Shim῾i: and the sons of Zerubbavel; Meshullam, and Ḥananya and Shelomith their sister:

verses.hebrew: וַחֲשֻׁבָה וָאֹהֶל וּבֶרֶכְיָה וַחֲסַדְיָה יוּשַׁב חֶסֶד חָמֵשׁ׃
verses.english: and Ḥashuva, and Ohel, and Berekhya, and Ḥasadya, Yushav-ĥesed; five.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־חֲנַנְיָה פְּלַטְיָה וִישַׁעְיָה בְּנֵי רְפָיָה בְּנֵי אַרְנָן בְּנֵי עֹבַדְיָה בְּנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Ḥananya; Pelatya, and Yesha῾aya: the sons of Refaya, the sons of Arnan, the sons of ῾Ovadya, the sons of Shekhanya.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה שְׁמַעְיָה וּבְנֵי שְׁמַעְיָה חַטּוּשׁ וְיִגְאָל וּבָרִיחַ וּנְעַרְיָה וְשָׁפָט שִׁשָּׁה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Shekhanya; Shema῾ya: and the sons of Shema῾ya; Ḥattush, and Yig᾽al, and Bariaĥ, and Ne῾arya; and Shafat, six.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־נְעַרְיָה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי וְחִזְקִיָּה וְעַזְרִיקָם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Ne῾arya; Elyo῾enay, and Ḥizqiyya, and ῾Azriqam; three.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי הדיוהו [הוֹדַוְיָהוּ] וְאֶלְיָשִׁיב וּפְלָיָה וְעַקּוּב וְיוֹחָנָן וּדְלָיָה וַעֲנָנִי שִׁבְעָה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Elyo῾enay were, Hodavyahu, and Elyashiv, and Pelaya, and ῾Aqquv, and Yoĥanan, and Delaya, and ῾Anani; seven.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה פֶּרֶץ חֶצְרוֹן וְכַרְמִי וְחוּר וְשׁוֹבָל׃
verses.english: The sons of Yehuda; Pereż, Ḥeżron, and Karni, and Ḥur, and Shoval.

verses.hebrew: וּרְאָיָה בֶן־שׁוֹבָל הוֹלִיד אֶת־יַחַת וְיַחַת הֹלִיד אֶת־אֲחוּמַי וְאֶת־לָהַד אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַצָּרְעָתִי׃
verses.english: And Re᾽aya the son of Shoval begot Yaĥat; and Yaĥat begot Aĥumay, and Lahad. These are the families of the Żora῾ti.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה אֲבִי עֵיטָם יִזְרְעֶאל וְיִשְׁמָא וְיִדְבָּשׁ וְשֵׁם אֲחוֹתָם הַצְלֶלְפּוֹנִי׃
verses.english: And these were of the father of ῾Etam; Yizre᾽el, and Yishma, and Yidbash: and the name of their sister was Hażżelelponi;

verses.hebrew: וּפְנוּאֵל אֲבִי גְדֹר וְעֵזֶר אֲבִי חוּשָׁה אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־חוּר בְּכוֹר אֶפְרָתָה אֲבִי בֵּית לָחֶם׃
verses.english: and Penu᾽el the father of Gedor, and ῾Eżer the father of Ḥusha. These are the sons of Ḥur, the firstborn of Efrata, the father of Bet-leĥem.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאַשְׁחוּר אֲבִי תְקוֹעַ הָיוּ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים חֶלְאָה וְנַעֲרָה׃
verses.english: And Ashĥur the father of Teqo῾a had two wives, Ḥel᾽a and Na῾ara.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ נַעֲרָה אֶת־אֲחֻזָּם וְאֶת־חֵפֶר וְאֶת־תֵּימְנִי וְאֶת־הָאֲחַשְׁתָּרִי אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי נַעֲרָה׃
verses.english: And Na῾ara bore him Aĥuzzam, and Ḥefer, and Temeni, and Aĥashtari. These were the sons of Na῾ara.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי חֶלְאָה צֶרֶת יצחר [וְצֹחַר] וְאֶתְנָן׃
verses.english: And the sons of Ḥel᾽a were, Żeret, and Żoĥar, and Etnan.

verses.hebrew: וְקוֹץ הוֹלִיד אֶת־עָנוּב וְאֶת־הַצֹּבֵבָה וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת אֲחַרְחֵל בֶּן־הָרוּם׃
verses.english: And Qoż begot ῾Anuv, and Żoveva, and the families of Aĥarĥel the son of Harum.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יַעְבֵּץ נִכְבָּד מֵאֶחָיו וְאִמּוֹ קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ יַעְבֵּץ לֵאמֹר כִּי יָלַדְתִּי בְּעֹצֶב׃
verses.english: And Ya῾beż was more honourable than his brothers; and his mother called his name Ya῾beż, saying, Because I bore him with pain.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעְבֵּץ לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִם־בָּרֵךְ תְּבָרֲכֵנִי וְהִרְבִּיתָ אֶת־גְּבוּלִי וְהָיְתָה יָדְךָ עִמִּי וְעָשִׂיתָ מֵּרָעָה לְבִלְתִּי עָצְבִּי וַיָּבֵא אֱלֹהִים אֵת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאָל׃
verses.english: And Ya῾beż called on the God of Yisra᾽el, saying, Oh that Thou wouldst bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that Thy hand might be with me, and that Thou wouldst keep me from harm, that it may not hurt me! And God granted him that which he requested.

verses.hebrew: וּכְלוּב אֲחִי־שׁוּחָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־מְחִיר הוּא אֲבִי אֶשְׁתּוֹן׃
verses.english: And Keluv the brother of Shuĥa begot Meĥir, who was the father of Eshton.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁתּוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת־בֵּית רָפָא וְאֶת־פָּסֵחַ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּה אֲבִי עִיר נָחָשׁ אֵלֶּה אַנְשֵׁי רֵכָה׃
verses.english: And Eshton begot Bet-rafa, and Paseaĥ, and Teĥinna the father of ῾Ir-naĥash. These are the men of Rekha.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קְנַז עָתְנִיאֵל וּשְׂרָיָה וּבְנֵי עָתְנִיאֵל חֲתַת׃
verses.english: And the sons of Qenaz; ῾Otni᾽el, and Seraya: and the sons of ῾Otni᾽el: Ḥatat.

verses.hebrew: וּמְעוֹנֹתַי הוֹלִיד אֶת־עָפְרָה וּשְׂרָיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־יוֹאָב אֲבִי גֵּיא חֲרָשִׁים כִּי חֲרָשִׁים הָיוּ׃
verses.english: And Me῾onotay begot ῾Ofra: and Seraya begot Yo᾽av, the father of the Ge-ĥarashim; for they were craftsmen.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה עִירוּ אֵלָה וָנָעַם וּבְנֵי אֵלָה וּקְנַז׃
verses.english: And the sons of Kalev the son of Yefunne; ῾Iru, Ela, and Na῾am: and the sons of Ela, even Qenaz.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יְהַלֶּלְאֵל זִיף וְזִיפָה תִּירְיָא וַאֲשַׂרְאֵל׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yehallel᾽el; Zif, and Zifa, Tirya, and Asar᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־עֶזְרָה יֶתֶר וּמֶרֶד וְעֵפֶר וְיָלוֹן וַתַּהַר אֶת־מִרְיָם וְאֶת־שַׁמַּי וְאֶת־יִשְׁבָּח אֲבִי אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ׃
verses.english: And the sons of ῾Ezra were, Yeter, and Mered, and ῾Efer, and Yalon: and she conceived Miryam, and Shammay, and Yishbaĥ the father of Eshtemoa.

verses.hebrew: וְאִשְׁתּוֹ הַיְהֻדִיָּה יָלְדָה אֶת־יֶרֶד אֲבִי גְדוֹר וְאֶת־חֶבֶר אֲבִי שׂוֹכוֹ וְאֶת־יְקוּתִיאֵל אֲבִי זָנוֹחַ וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בִּתְיָה בַת־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מָרֶד׃
verses.english: And his wife Yehudiyya bore Yered the father of Gedor, and Ḥever the father of Sokho, and Yequti᾽el the father of Zanoaĥ. And these are the sons of Bitya the daughter of Par῾o whom Mered took.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֵשֶׁת הוֹדִיָּה אֲחוֹת נַחַם אֲבִי קְעִילָה הַגַּרְמִי וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ הַמַּעֲכָתִי׃
verses.english: And the sons of the wife of Hodiyya the sister of Naĥam, the father of Qe῾ila the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Ma῾akhatite.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שִׁימוֹן אַמְנוֹן וְרִנָּה בֶּן־חָנָן ותולון [וְתִילוֹן] וּבְנֵי יִשְׁעִי זוֹחֵת וּבֶן־זוֹחֵת׃
verses.english: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinna, Ben-ĥanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Yish῾i were, Zoĥet, and Ben-zoĥet.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שֵׁלָה בֶן־יְהוּדָה עֵר אֲבִי לֵכָה וְלַעְדָּה אֲבִי מָרֵשָׁה וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת בֵּית־עֲבֹדַת הַבֻּץ לְבֵית אַשְׁבֵּעַ׃
verses.english: The sons of Shela the son of Yehuda were, ῾Er the father of Lekha, and La῾ada the father of Maresha, and the families of the house of the linen workers, of the house of Ashbea,

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹקִים וְאַנְשֵׁי כֹזֵבָא וְיוֹאָשׁ וְשָׂרָף אֲשֶׁר־בָּעֲלוּ לְמוֹאָב וְיָשֻׁבִי לָחֶם וְהַדְּבָרִים עַתִּיקִים׃
verses.english: and Yoqim, and the men of Kozeva, and Yo᾽ash, and Saraf, who ruled in Mo᾽av, and Yashuvi-leĥem (But the records are ancient.)

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה הַיּוֹצְרִים וְיֹשְׁבֵי נְטָעִים וּגְדֵרָה עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּמְלַאכְתּוֹ יָשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃
verses.english: These were the potters, and those who dwelt among plantations and hedges: there they dwelt, occupied with the king’s work.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן נְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין יָרִיב זֶרַח שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: The sons of Shim῾on were, Nemu᾽el, and Yamin, Yariv, Zeraĥ and Sha᾽ul:

verses.hebrew: שַׁלֻּם בְּנוֹ מִבְשָׂם בְּנוֹ מִשְׁמָע בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Shallum his son, Mivsam his son, Mishma his son.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מִשְׁמָע חַמּוּאֵל בְּנוֹ זַכּוּר בְּנוֹ שִׁמְעִי בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: And the sons of Mishma; Ḥammu᾽el his son, Zakkur his son, Shim῾i his son.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשִׁמְעִי בָּנִים שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר וּבָנוֹת שֵׁשׁ וּלְאֶחָיו אֵין בָּנִים רַבִּים וְכֹל מִשְׁפַּחְתָּם לֹא הִרְבּוּ עַד־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: And Shim῾i had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers had not many children, nor did all their family multiply, like the children of Yehuda.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בִּבְאֵר־שֶׁבַע וּמוֹלָדָה וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל׃
verses.english: And they dwelt at Be᾽er-sheva, and Molada, and Ḥażar-shu῾al.

verses.hebrew: וּבְבִלְהָה וּבְעֶצֶם וּבְתוֹלָד׃
verses.english: and at Bilha, and at ῾Eżem, and at Tolad,

verses.hebrew: וּבִבְתוּאֵל וּבְחָרְמָה וּבְצִיקְלָג׃
verses.english: and at Betu᾽el, and at Ḥorma, and at Żiqlag,

verses.hebrew: וּבְבֵית מַרְכָּבוֹת וּבַחֲצַר סוּסִים וּבְבֵית בִּרְאִי וּבְשַׁעֲרָיִם אֵלֶּה עָרֵיהֶם עַד־מְלֹךְ דָּוִיד׃
verses.english: and at Bet-markavot, and Ḥażar-susim, and at Bet-bir᾽i, and at Sha῾arayim. These were their cities until the reign of David.

verses.hebrew: וְחַצְרֵיהֶם עֵיטָם וָעַיִן רִמּוֹן וְתֹכֶן וְעָשָׁן עָרִים חָמֵשׁ׃
verses.english: And their settlements were, ῾Etam, and ῾Ayin, Rimmon, and Tokhen, and ῾Ashan; five cities:

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־חַצְרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עַד־בָּעַל זֹאת מוֹשְׁבֹתָם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם לָהֶם׃
verses.english: and all their settlements that were round about the same cities as far as Ba῾al. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

verses.hebrew: וּמְשׁוֹבָב וְיַמְלֵךְ וְיוֹשָׁה בֶּן־אֲמַצְיָה׃
verses.english: And Meshovav, and Yamlekh, and Yosha the son of Amażya.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאֵל וְיֵהוּא בֶּן־יוֹשִׁבְיָה בֶּן־שְׂרָיָה בֶּן־עֲשִׂיאֵל׃
verses.english: And Yo᾽el, and Yehu the son of Yoshivya, the son of Seraya, the son of ῾Asi᾽el,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַי וְיַעֲקֹבָה וִישׁוֹחָיָה וַעֲשָׂיָה וַעֲדִיאֵל וִישִׂימִאֵל וּבְנָיָה׃
verses.english: and Elyo῾enay, and Ya῾aqova, and Yeshoĥaya, and ῾Asaya, and ῾Adi᾽el, and Yesimi᾽el, and Benaya.

verses.hebrew: וְזִיזָא בֶן־שִׁפְעִי בֶן־אַלּוֹן בֶּן־יְדָיָה בֶן־שִׁמְרִי בֶּן־שְׁמַעְיָה׃
verses.english: and Ziza the son of Shif῾i, the son of Allon, the son of Yedaya, the son of Shimri, the son of Shema῾ya;

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַבָּאִים בְּשֵׁמוֹת נְשִׂיאִים בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם וּבֵית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם פָּרְצוּ לָרוֹב׃
verses.english: these mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ לִמְבוֹא גְדֹר עַד לְמִזְרַח הַגָּיְא לְבַקֵּשׁ מִרְעֶה לְצֹאנָם׃
verses.english: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצְאוּ מִרְעֶה שָׁמֵן וָטוֹב וְהָאָרֶץ רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם וְשֹׁקֶטֶת וּשְׁלֵוָה כִּי מִן־חָם הַיֹּשְׁבִים שָׁם לְפָנִים׃
verses.english: And they found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ḥam had dwelt there of old.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלֶּה הַכְּתוּבִים בְּשֵׁמוֹת בִּימֵי יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־אָהֳלֵיהֶם וְאֶת־המעינים [הַמְּעוּנִים] אֲשֶׁר נִמְצְאוּ־שָׁמָּה וַיַּחֲרִימֻם עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַּחְתֵּיהֶם כִּי־מִרְעֶה לְצֹאנָם שָׁם׃
verses.english: And these written by name came in the days of Yeĥizqiyyahu king of Yehuda, and smote their tents, and the Me῾unim who were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

verses.hebrew: וּמֵהֶם מִן־בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן הָלְכוּ לְהַר שֵׂעִיר אֲנָשִׁים חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּפְלַטְיָה וּנְעַרְיָה וּרְפָיָה וְעֻזִּיאֵל בְּנֵי יִשְׁעִי בְּרֹאשָׁם׃
verses.english: And some of them, of the sons of Shim῾on, five hundred men, went to mount Se῾ir, having as their leaders Pelatya, and Ne῾arya, and Refaya, and ῾Uzzi᾽el, the sons of Yish῾i.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־שְׁאֵרִית הַפְּלֵטָה לַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And they smote the remnant of ῾Amaleq who had escaped, and dwelt there to this day.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי הוּא הַבְּכוֹר וּבְחַלְּלוֹ יְצוּעֵי אָבִיו נִתְּנָה בְּכֹרָתוֹ לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא לְהִתְיַחֵשׂ לַבְּכֹרָה׃
verses.english: Now the sons of Re᾽uven the firstborn of Yisra᾽el, (for he was the firstborn; but, since he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Yosef the son of Yisra᾽el: but not so as to have the birthright attributed to him by genealogy.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהוּדָה גָּבַר בְּאֶחָיו וּלְנָגִיד מִמֶּנּוּ וְהַבְּכֹרָה לְיוֹסֵף׃
verses.english: For Yehuda prevailed over his brothers, and of him came the chief ruler; though the birthright was Yosef’s:)

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲנוֹךְ וּפַלּוּא חֶצְרוֹן וְכַרְמִי׃
verses.english: the sons of Re᾽uven the firstborn of Yisra᾽el were, Ḥanokh, and Pallu, Ḥeżron, and Karmi.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יוֹאֵל שְׁמַעְיָה בְנוֹ גּוֹג בְּנוֹ שִׁמְעִי בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: The sons of Yo᾽el; Shema῾ya his son, Gog his son, Shim῾i his son,

verses.hebrew: מִיכָה בְנוֹ רְאָיָה בְנוֹ בַּעַל בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Mikha his son, Re᾽aya his son, Ba῾al his son,

verses.hebrew: בְּאֵרָה בְנוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה תִּלְּגַת פִּלְנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשֻּׁר הוּא נָשִׂיא לָראוּבֵנִי׃
verses.english: Be᾽era his son, whom Tilgat-piln᾽eser king of Ashshur carried away into exile: he was prince of the Re᾽uveni.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶחָיו לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו בְּהִתְיַחֵשׂ לְתֹלְדוֹתָם הָרֹאשׁ יְעִיאֵל וּזְכַרְיָהוּ׃
verses.english: And his brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Ye῾i᾽el, and Zekharyahu,

verses.hebrew: וּבֶלַע בֶּן־עָזָז בֶּן־שֶׁמַע בֶּן־יוֹאֵל הוּא יוֹשֵׁב בַּעֲרֹעֵר וְעַד־נְבוֹ וּבַעַל מְעוֹן׃
verses.english: and Bela the son of ῾Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Yo᾽el, who dwelt in ῾Aro῾er, as far as Nevo and Ba῾al-me῾on:

verses.hebrew: וְלַמִּזְרָח יָשַׁב עַד־לְבוֹא מִדְבָּרָה לְמִן־הַנָּהָר פְּרָת כִּי מִקְנֵיהֶם רָבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: and eastward he inhabited as far as the entrance of the wilderness from the river Perat: because their cattle had multiplied in the land of Gil῾ad.

verses.hebrew: וּבִימֵי שָׁאוּל עָשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה עִם־הַהַגְרִאִים וַיִּפְּלוּ בְּיָדָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם עַל־כָּל־פְּנֵי מִזְרָח לַגִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: And in the days of Sha᾽ul they made war with the Hagri᾽im, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gil῾ad.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי־גָד לְנֶגְדָּם יָשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ הַבָּשָׁן עַד־סַלְכָה׃
verses.english: And the children of Gad dwelt opposite them, in the land of the Bashan as far as Salkha:

verses.hebrew: יוֹאֵל הָרֹאשׁ וְשָׁפָם הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְיַעְנַי וְשָׁפָט בַּבָּשָׁן׃
verses.english: Yo᾽el the chief, and Shafam the next, and Ya῾nay, and Shafat in the Bashan.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֵיהֶם לְבֵית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם מִיכָאֵל וּמְשֻׁלָּם וְשֶׁבַע וְיוֹרַי וְיַעְכָּן וְזִיעַ וָעֵבֶר שִׁבְעָה׃
verses.english: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Mikha᾽el, and Meshullam, and Sheva, and Yoray, and Ya῾kan, and Zia, and ῾Ever; seven.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֲבִיחַיִל בֶּן־חוּרִי בֶּן־יָרוֹחַ בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל בֶּן־יְשִׁישַׁי בֶּן־יַחְדּוֹ בֶּן־בּוּז׃
verses.english: These are the children of Aviĥayil the son of Ḥuri, the son of Yaroaĥ, the son of Gil῾ad, the son of Mikha᾽el, the son of Yeshishay, the son of Yaĥdo, the son of Buz;

verses.hebrew: אֲחִי בֶּן־עַבְדִּיאֵל בֶּן־גּוּנִי רֹאשׁ לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Aĥi the son of Avdi᾽el, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בַּגִּלְעָד בַּבָּשָׁן וּבִבְנֹתֶיהָ וּבְכָל־מִגְרְשֵׁי שָׁרוֹן עַל־תּוֹצְאוֹתָם׃
verses.english: And they dwelt in Gil῾ad in the Bashan, and in its hamlets, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon, to their limits.

verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם הִתְיַחְשׂוּ בִּימֵי יוֹתָם מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וּבִימֵי יָרָבְעָם מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Yotam king of Yehuda, and in the days of Yarov῾am king of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְגָדִי וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה מִן־בְּנֵי־חַיִל אֲנָשִׁים נֹשְׂאֵי מָגֵן וְחֶרֶב וְדֹרְכֵי קֶשֶׁת וּלְמוּדֵי מִלְחָמָה אַרְבָּעִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים יֹצְאֵי צָבָא׃
verses.english: The sons of Re᾽uven, and the Gadi, and half the tribe of Menashshe, of men at arms, able to bear shield and sword, and to draw the bow, and skilful in war, were forty four thousand seven hundred and sixty, who went out to war.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה עִם־הַהַגְרִיאִים וִיטוּר וְנָפִישׁ וְנוֹדָב׃
verses.english: And they made war with the Hagri᾽im, with Yetur, and Nafish, and Nodav.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּעָזְרוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּנָּתְנוּ בְיָדָם הַהַגְרִיאִים וְכֹל שֶׁעִמָּהֶם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים זָעֲקוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְנַעְתּוֹר לָהֶם כִּי־בָטְחוּ בוֹ׃
verses.english: And they were helped against them, and the Hagri᾽im were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he granted their entreaty: because they put their trust in him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ מִקְנֵיהֶם גְּמַלֵּיהֶם חֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְצֹאן מָאתַיִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמוֹרִים אַלְפָּיִם וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מֵאָה אָלֶף׃
verses.english: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חֲלָלִים רַבִּים נָפָלוּ כִּי מֵהָאֱלֹהִים הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתֵּיהֶם עַד־הַגֹּלָה׃
verses.english: For there fell down many slain, because the war was from God. And they dwelt in their stead until the exile.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה יָשְׁבוּ בָּאָרֶץ מִבָּשָׁן עַד־בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן וּשְׂנִיר וְהַר־חֶרְמוֹן הֵמָּה רָבוּ׃
verses.english: And the children of the half tribe of Menashshe dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan to Ba῾al-ĥermon and Senir, and to mount Ḥermon.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי בֵית־אֲבוֹתָם וְעֵפֶר וְיִשְׁעִי וֶאֱלִיאֵל וְעַזְרִיאֵל וְיִרְמְיָה וְהוֹדַוְיָה וְיַחְדִּיאֵל אֲנָשִׁים גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל אַנְשֵׁי שֵׁמוֹת רָאשִׁים לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: And these were the heads of the houses of their fathers, ῾Efer, and Yish῾i, and Eli᾽el, and ῾Azri᾽el, and Yirmeya, and Hodavya, and Yaĥdi᾽el, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the houses of their fathers.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְעֲלוּ בֵּאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵי עַמֵּי־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הִשְׁמִיד אֱלֹהִים מִפְּנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went astray after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּעַר אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־רוּחַ פּוּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וְאֶת־רוּחַ תִּלְּגַת פִּלְנֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּגְלֵם לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה וַיְבִיאֵם לַחְלַח וְחָבוֹר וְהָרָא וּנְהַר גּוֹזָן עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And the God of Yisra᾽el stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Ashshur, and the spirit of Tilgat-piln᾽eser king of Ashshur, and he carried them away, namely the Re᾽uveni, and the Gadi, and the half tribe of Menashshe, and brought them to Ḥalaĥ, and Ḥavor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, to this day.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי לֵוִי גֵּרְשׁוֹן קְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃
verses.english: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Qehat, and Merari.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם יִצְהָר וְחֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל׃
verses.english: And the sons of Qehat; ῾Amram, Yiżhar, and Ḥevron, and ῾Uzzi᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עַמְרָם אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה וּמִרְיָם וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר׃
verses.english: And the children of ῾Amram: Aharon, and Moshe, and Miryam. And the sons of Aharon; Nadav, and Avihu, El῾azar, and Itamar.

verses.hebrew: אֶלְעָזָר הוֹלִיד אֶת־פִּינְחָס פִּינְחָס הֹלִיד אֶת־אֲבִישׁוּעַ׃
verses.english: El῾azar begot Pineĥas, Pineĥas begot Avishua,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִישׁוּעַ הוֹלִיד אֶת־בֻּקִּי וּבֻקִּי הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֻזִּי׃
verses.english: and Avishua begot Buqqi, and Buqqi begot ῾Uzzi,

verses.hebrew: וְעֻזִּי הוֹלִיד אֶת־זְרַחְיָה וּזְרַחְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־מְרָיוֹת׃
verses.english: and ῾Uzzi begot Zeraĥya, and Zeraĥya begot Merayot;

verses.hebrew: מְרָיוֹת הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲמַרְיָה וַאֲמַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲחִיטוּב׃
verses.english: Merayot begot Amarya, and Amarya begot Aĥituv,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִיטוּב הוֹלִיד אֶת־צָדוֹק וְצָדוֹק הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲחִימָעַץ׃
verses.english: and Aĥituv begot Żadoq, and Żadoq begot Aĥima῾aż,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִימַעַץ הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה וַעֲזַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־יוֹחָנָן׃
verses.english: and Aĥima῾aż begot ῾Azarya, and ῾Azarya begot Yoĥanan,

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹחָנָן הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה הוּא אֲשֶׁר כִּהֵן בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: and Yoĥanan begot ῾Azarya, (he it is who executed the priest’s office in the temple that Shelomo built in Yerushalayim:)

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹלֶד עֲזַרְיָה אֶת־אֲמַרְיָה וַאֲמַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲחִיטוּב׃
verses.english: and ῾Azarya begot Amarya, and Amarya begot Aĥituv,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִיטוּב הוֹלִיד אֶת־צָדוֹק וְצָדוֹק הוֹלִיד אֶת־שַׁלּוּם׃
verses.english: and Aĥituv begot Żadoq, and Żadoq begot Shallum,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁלּוּם הוֹלִיד אֶת־חִלְקִיָּה וְחִלְקִיָּה הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה׃
verses.english: and Shallum begot Ḥilqiyya, and Ḥilqiyya begot ῾Azarya,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲזַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־שְׂרָיָה וּשְׂרָיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־יְהוֹצָדָק׃
verses.english: and ῾Azarya begot Seraya, and Seraya begot Yehożadaq,

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹצָדָק הָלַךְ בְּהַגְלוֹת יְהוָה אֶת־יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָם בְּיַד נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר׃
verses.english: and Yehożadaq went into exile, when the Lord carried away Yehuda and Yerushalayim by the hand of Nevu­khad­neżżar.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי לֵוִי גֵּרְשֹׁם קְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃
verses.english: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Qehat, and Merari.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי־גֵרְשׁוֹם לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִי׃
verses.english: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom; Livni, and Shim῾i.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר וְחֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל׃
verses.english: And the sons of Qehat were, ῾Amram, and Yiżhar, and Ḥevron, and ῾Uzzi᾽el.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמֻשִׁי וְאֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַלֵּוִי לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: The sons of Merari; Maĥli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

verses.hebrew: לְגֵרְשׁוֹם לִבְנִי בְנוֹ יַחַת בְּנוֹ זִמָּה בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Of Gershom; Livni his son, Yaĥat his son, Zimma his son,

verses.hebrew: יוֹאָח בְּנוֹ עִדּוֹ בְנוֹ זֶרַח בְּנוֹ יְאָתְרַי בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Yoaĥ his son, ῾Iddo his son, Zeraĥ his son, Ye᾽ateray his son.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי קְהָת עַמִּינָדָב בְּנוֹ קֹרַח בְּנוֹ אַסִּיר בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: The sons of Qehat; ῾Amminadav his son, Qoraĥ his son, Assir his son,

verses.hebrew: אֶלְקָנָה בְנוֹ וְאֶבְיָסָף בְּנוֹ וְאַסִּיר בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Elqana his son, and Evyasaf his son, and Assir his son,

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת בְּנוֹ אוּרִיאֵל בְּנוֹ עֻזִּיָּה בְנוֹ וְשָׁאוּל בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Taĥat his son, Uri᾽el his son, ῾Uzziyya his son, and Sha᾽ul his son.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֶלְקָנָה עֲמָשַׂי וַאֲחִימוֹת׃
verses.english: And the sons of Elqana; ῾Amasay, and Ahimot.

verses.hebrew: אֶלְקָנָה בנו [בְּנֵי] אֶלְקָנָה צוֹפַי בְּנוֹ וְנַחַת בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: As for Elqana: the sons of Elqana; Żafay his son, and Naĥat his son.

verses.hebrew: אֱלִיאָב בְּנוֹ יְרֹחָם בְּנוֹ אֶלְקָנָה בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Eli᾽av his son, Yeroĥam his son, Elqana his son.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל הַבְּכֹר וַשְׁנִי וַאֲבִיָּה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Shemu᾽el; the firstborn Vashni, and Aviyya.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי לִבְנִי בְנוֹ שִׁמְעִי בְנוֹ עֻזָּה בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: The sons of Merari; Maĥli, Livni his son, Shim῾i his son, ῾Uzza his son,

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעָא בְנוֹ חַגִּיָּה בְנוֹ עֲשָׂיָה בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Shim῾a his son, Ḥaggiyya his son, ῾Asaya his son.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱמִיד דָּוִיד עַל־יְדֵי־שִׁיר בֵּית יְהוָה מִמְּנוֹחַ הָאָרוֹן׃
verses.english: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after the ark had rest.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ מְשָׁרְתִים לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד בַּשִּׁיר עַד־בְּנוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וַיַּעַמְדוּ כְמִשְׁפָּטָם עַל־עֲבוֹדָתָם׃
verses.english: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the Tent of Meeting with singing, until Shelomo had built the house of the Lord in Yerushalayim: and then they performed their office according to their order.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים וּבְנֵיהֶם מִבְּנֵי הַקְּהָתִי הֵימָן הַמְשׁוֹרֵר בֶּן־יוֹאֵל בֶּן־שְׁמוּאֵל׃
verses.english: And these are the men who served with their sons. Of the sons of the Qehati; Heman the singer, the son of Yo᾽el, the son of Shemu᾽el,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם בֶּן־אֱלִיאֵל בֶּן־תּוֹחַ׃
verses.english: the son of Elqana, the son of Yeroĥam, the son of Eli᾽el, the son of Toaĥ,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־ציף [צוּף] בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־מַחַת בֶּן־עֲמָשָׂי׃
verses.english: the son of Żuf, the son of Elqana, the son of Maĥat, the son of ῾Amasay,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־יוֹאֵל בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָה בֶּן־צְפַנְיָה׃
verses.english: the son of Elqana, the son of Yo᾽el, the son of ῾Azarya, the son of Żefanya,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־תַּחַת בֶּן־אַסִּיר בֶּן־אֶבְיָסָף בֶּן־קֹרַח׃
verses.english: the son of Taĥat, the son of Assir, the son of Evyasaf, the son of Qoraĥ,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־יִצְהָר בֶּן־קְהָת בֶּן־לֵוִי בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: the son of Yiżhar, the son of Qehat, the son of Levi, the son of Yisra᾽el,

verses.hebrew: וְאָחִיו אָסָף הָעֹמֵד עַל־יְמִינוֹ אָסָף בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ בֶּן־שִׁמְעָא׃
verses.english: and his brother Asaf, who stood on his right hand, Asaf the son of Berekhyahu, son of Shim῾a,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל בֶּן־בַּעֲשֵׂיָה בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּה׃
verses.english: the son of Mikha᾽el, the son of Ba῾aseya, the son of Malkiyya,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֶתְנִי בֶן־זֶרַח בֶּן־עֲדָיָה׃
verses.english: the son of Etni, the son of Zeraĥ, the son of ῾Adaya,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֵיתָן בֶּן־זִמָּה בֶּן־שִׁמְעִי׃
verses.english: the son of Etan, the son of Zimma, the son of Shim῾i,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־יַחַת בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁם בֶּן־לֵוִי׃
verses.english: the son of Yaĥat, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי אֲחֵיהֶם עַל־הַשְּׂמֹאול אֵיתָן בֶּן־קִישִׁי בֶּן־עַבְדִּי בֶּן־מַלּוּךְ׃
verses.english: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Etan the son of Qishi, the son of ῾Avdi, the son of Mallukh,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה׃
verses.english: the son of Ḥashavya, the son of Amażya, the son of Ḥilqiyya,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אַמְצִי בֶן־בָּנִי בֶּן־שָׁמֶר׃
verses.english: the son of Amżi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־מַחְלִי בֶּן־מוּשִׁי בֶּן־מְרָרִי בֶּן־לֵוִי׃
verses.english: the son of Maĥli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם נְתוּנִים לְכָל־עֲבוֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: And their brethren the Levites were appointed to all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

verses.hebrew: וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַקְטִירִים עַל־מִזְבַּח הָעוֹלָה וְעַל־מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת לְכֹל מְלֶאכֶת קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּלְכַפֵּר עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: But Aharon and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Yisra᾽el, according to all that Moshe the servant of God had commanded.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ פִּינְחָס בְּנוֹ אֲבִישׁוּעַ בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: And these are the sons of Aharon; El῾azar his son, Pineĥas his son, Avishua his son,

verses.hebrew: בֻּקִּי בְנוֹ עֻזִּי בְנוֹ זְרַחְיָה בְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Buqqi his son, ῾Uzzi his son, Zeraĥya his son,

verses.hebrew: מְרָיוֹת בְּנוֹ אֲמַרְיָה בְנוֹ אֲחִיטוּב בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Merayot his son, Amarya his son, Aĥituv his son,

verses.hebrew: צָדוֹק בְּנוֹ אֲחִימַעַץ בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Żadoq his son, Aĥima῾aż his son.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מוֹשְׁבוֹתָם לְטִירוֹתָם בִּגְבוּלָם לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן לְמִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל׃
verses.english: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their encampments in their borders, of the sons of Aharon, of the families of the Qehati: for theirs was the lot.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: And they gave them Ḥevron in the land of Yehuda, and its pasture lands round about it.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־שְׂדֵה הָעִיר וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶיהָ נָתְנוּ לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה׃
verses.english: But the fields of the city, and its farmsteads, they gave to Kalev the son of Yefunne.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָתְנוּ אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן וְאֶת־לִבְנָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־יַתִּר וְאֶת־אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: And to the sons of Aharon they gave the cities of refuge, Ḥevron, and Livna with its pasture lands, and Yattir, and Eshtemoa, with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חִילֵז וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת־דְּבִיר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and Ḥilen with its pasture lands, Devir with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עָשָׁן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and ῾Ashan with its pasture lands, and Bet-shemesh with its pasture lands:

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֶת־גֶּבַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עָלֶמֶת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עֲנָתוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ כָּל־עָרֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה עִיר בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: and out of the tribe of Binyamin; Geva with its pasture lands, and ῾Alemet with its pasture lands, and ῾Anatot with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּטֶּה מִמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה חֲצִי מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָשֶׂר׃
verses.english: And to the rest of the sons of Kehat, were given by lot, out of the family of that tribe, out of the half tribe, the half of Menashshe, ten cities.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹם לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה יִשָׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּה אָשֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וּמִמַּטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַּבָּשָׁן עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃
verses.english: And to the sons of Gershom according to their families out of the tribe of Yissakhar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naftali, and out of the tribe of Menashshe in the Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד וּמִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃
verses.english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Re᾽uven, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zevulun, twelve cities.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת־הֶעָרִים וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם׃
verses.english: And the children of Yisra᾽el gave to the Levites these cities with their pasture lands.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בַגּוֹרָל מִמַּטֵּה בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן וּמִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֵת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרְאוּ אֶתְהֶם בְּשֵׁמוֹת׃
verses.english: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Yehuda and out of the tribe of the children of Shim῾on, and out of the tribe of the children of Binyamin, these cities, which are mentioned by names.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי קְהָת וַיְהִי עָרֵי גְבוּלָם מִמַּטֵּה אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: And some of the families of the sons of Qehat had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Efrayim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֶת־שְׁכֶם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־גֶּזֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: For they gave to them the cities of refuge, Shekhem in mount Efrayim with its pasture lands; and Gezer with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־יָקְמְעָם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־בֵּית חוֹרוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and Yoqme῾am with its pasture lands, and Bet-ĥoron with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אַיָּלוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־גַּת־רִמּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and Ayyalon with its pasture lands, and Gat-rimmon with its pasture lands:

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־עָנֵר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־בִּלְעָם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת לִבְנֵי־קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים׃
verses.english: and out of the half tribe of Menashshe; ῾Aner with its pasture lands, and Bil῾am with its pasture lands, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Qehat.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי גֵּרְשׁוֹם מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת חֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־גּוֹלָן בַּבָּשָׁן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: To the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Menashshe, Golan in the Bashan with its pasture lands, and ῾Ashtarot with its pasture lands:

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה יִשָׂשכָר אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת־דָּבְרַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and out of the tribe of Yissakhar; Qedesh with its pasture lands, Daverat, with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־רָאמוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עָנֵם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and Ramot with its pasture lands, and ῾Anam with its pasture lands:

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה אָשֵׁר אֶת־מָשָׁל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עַבְדּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with its pasture lands, and ῾Avdon with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חוּקֹק וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־רְחֹב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and Ḥuqoq with its pasture lands and Reĥov with its pasture lands:

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־חַמּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־קִרְיָתַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and out of the tribe of Naftali, Qedesh in the Galil with its pasture lands, and Ḥammon with its pasture lands, and Qiryatayim with its pasture lands.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן אֶת־רִמּוֹנוֹ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת־תָּבוֹר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: To the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zevulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, Tavor with its pasture lands:

verses.hebrew: וּמֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לְמִזְרַח הַיַּרְדֵּן מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן אֶת־בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־יַהְצָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and on the other side of Yarden by Yeriĥo, on the east side of the Yarden, were given them out of the tribes of Re᾽uven, Beżer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, and Yahża with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־קְדֵמוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־מֵיפַעַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and Qedemot with its pasture lands, and Mefa῾at with its pasture lands:

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד אֶת־רָאמוֹת בַּגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־מַחֲנַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and out of the tribe of Gad; Ramot in the Gil῾ad with its pasture lands, and Maĥanayim with its pasture lands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־יַעְזֵיר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ׃
verses.english: and Ḥeshbon with its pasture lands, and Ya῾zer with its pasture lands.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי יִשָׂשכָר תּוֹלָע וּפוּאָה ישיב [יָשׁוּב] וְשִׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעָה׃
verses.english: Now the sons of Yissakhar were, Tola, and Pu῾a, Yashuv, and Shimron, four.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי תוֹלָע עֻזִּי וּרְפָיָה וִירִיאֵל וְיַחְמַי וְיִבְשָׂם וּשְׁמוּאֵל רָאשִׁים לְבֵית־אֲבוֹתָם לְתוֹלָע גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל לְתֹלְדוֹתָם מִסְפָּרָם בִּימֵי דָוִיד עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃
verses.english: And the sons of Tola; ῾Uzzi, and Refaya, and Yeri᾽el, and Yaĥmay, and Yivsam, and Shemu᾽el, heads of their father’s houses, that is, of Tola; were valiant men at arms in their generations: their number in the days of David was twenty two thousand six hundred.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עֻזִּי יִזְרַחְיָה וּבְנֵי יִזְרַחְיָה מִיכָאֵל וְעֹבַדְיָה וְיוֹאֵל יִשִּׁיָּה חֲמִשָּׁה רָאשִׁים כֻּלָּם׃
verses.english: And the sons of ῾Uzzi; Yizraĥya: and the sons of Yizraĥya; Mikhal, and ῾Ovadya and Yo᾽el, Yishshiyya; five: all of them chief men.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲלֵיהֶם לְתֹלְדוֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם גְּדוּדֵי צְבָא מִלְחָמָה שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה אָלֶף כִּי־הִרְבּוּ נָשִׁים וּבָנִים׃
verses.english: And with them, by their generations, after the houses of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war; thirty six thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֵיהֶם לְכֹל מִשְׁפְּחוֹת יִשָׂשכָר גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים שְׁמוֹנִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂם לַכֹּל׃
verses.english: And their brethren among all the families of Yissakhar, valiant men at arms, reckoned in all by their genealogies, eighty seven thousand.

verses.hebrew: בִּנְיָמִן בֶּלַע וָבֶכֶר וִידִיעֲאֵל שְׁלֹשָׁה׃
verses.english: The sons of Binyamin; Bela, and Bekher, and Yedi῾a᾽el; three.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בֶלַע אֶצְבּוֹן וְעֻזִּי וְעֻזִּיאֵל וִירִימוֹת וְעִירִי חֲמִשָּׁה רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אָבוֹת גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַרְבָּעָה׃
verses.english: And the sons of Bela; Eżbon, and ῾Uzzi, and ῾Uzzi᾽el, and Yerimot, and ῾Iri; five; heads of the houses of their fathers, mighty men at arms; and were reckoned by their genealogies, twenty two thousand and thirty four.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בֶכֶר זְמִירָה וְיוֹעָשׁ וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַי וְעָמְרִי וִירֵמוֹת וַאֲבִיָּה וַעֲנָתוֹת וְעָלָמֶת כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי־בָכֶר׃
verses.english: And the sons of Bekher; Zemira, and Yo᾽ash, and Eli῾ezer, and Elyo῾enay, and ῾Omri, and Yeremot, and Aviyya, and ῾Anatot, and ῾Alemet. All these were the sons of Bekher.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם לְתֹלְדוֹתָם רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם גִּבּוֹרֵי חָיִל עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃
verses.english: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the houses of their fathers, mighty men at arms, was twenty thousand two hundred.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יְדִיעֲאֵל בִּלְהָן וּבְנֵי בִלְהָן יעיש [יְעוּשׁ] וּבִנְיָמִן וְאֵהוּד וּכְנַעֲנָה וְזֵיתָן וְתַרְשִׁישׁ וַאֲחִישָׁחַר׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yedi῾a᾽el; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Ye῾ush, and Binyamin, and Eĥud, and Kena῾ana, and Zetan, and Tarshish, and Aĥishaĥar.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יְדִיעֲאֵל לְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים שִׁבְעָה־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף וּמָאתַיִם יֹצְאֵי צָבָא לַמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: All these were the sons of Yedi῾a᾽el, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men at arms, seventeen thousand two hundred, fit to go out to war and battle.

verses.hebrew: וְשֻׁפִּם וְחֻפִּם בְּנֵי עִיר חֻשִׁם בְּנֵי אַחֵר׃
verses.english: And Shuppim, and Ḥuppim, the children of ῾Ir, and Ḥushim, the sons of Aĥer.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יַחֲצִיאֵל וְגוּנִי וְיֵצֶר וְשַׁלּוּם בְּנֵי בִלְהָה׃
verses.english: The sons of Naftali; Yaĥżi᾽el, and Guni, and Yeżer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilha.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה אַשְׂרִיאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָלָדָה פִּילַגְשׁוֹ הָאֲרַמִּיָּה יָלְדָה אֶת־מָכִיר אֲבִי גִלְעָד׃
verses.english: The sons of Menashshe; Asri᾽el, whom she bore: (but his concubine, the Arammian woman, bore Makhir the father of Gil῾ad:

verses.hebrew: וּמָכִיר לָקַח אִשָּׁה לְחֻפִּים וּלְשֻׁפִּים וְשֵׁם אֲחֹתוֹ מַעֲכָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי צְלָפְחָד וַתִּהְיֶנָה לִצְלָפְחָד בָּנוֹת׃
verses.english: and Makhir took to wife one of the family of Ḥuppim and Shuppim, a sister, whose name was Ma῾akha;) and the name of the second was Żelofĥad: and Żelofĥad had daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד מַעֲכָה אֵשֶׁת־מָכִיר בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ פֶּרֶשׁ וְשֵׁם אָחִיו שָׁרֶשׁ וּבָנָיו אוּלָם וָרָקֶם׃
verses.english: And Ma῾akha the wife of Makhir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Reqem.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אוּלָם בְּדָן אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי גִלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: And the son of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gil῾ad, the son of Makhir, the son of Menashshe.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֹתוֹ הַמֹּלֶכֶת יָלְדָה אֶת־אִישְׁהוֹד וְאֶת־אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְאֶת־מַחְלָה׃
verses.english: And his sister Hammolekhet bore Ishhod, and Avi῾ezer, and Maĥla.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי שְׁמִידָע אַחְיָן וָשֶׁכֶם וְלִקְחִי וַאֲנִיעָם׃
verses.english: And the sons of Shemida were, Aĥyan, and Shekhem, and Liqĥi, and Ani῾am.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם שׁוּתָלַח וּבֶרֶד בְּנוֹ וְתַחַת בְּנוֹ וְאֶלְעָדָה בְנוֹ וְתַחַת בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: And the sons of Efrayim; Shutelaĥ, and Bered his son, and Taĥat his son, and El῾ada his son, and Taĥat his son,

verses.hebrew: וְזָבָד בְּנוֹ וְשׁוּתֶלַח בְּנוֹ וְעֵזֶר וְאֶלְעָד וַהֲרָגוּם אַנְשֵׁי־גַת הַנּוֹלָדִים בָּאָרֶץ כִּי יָרְדוּ לָקַחַת אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: and Zavad his son, and Shutelaĥ his son, and ῾Eżer, and El῾ad, whom the men of Gat that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַבֵּל אֶפְרַיִם אֲבִיהֶם יָמִים רַבִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶחָיו לְנַחֲמוֹ׃
verses.english: And Efrayim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ בְּרִיעָה כִּי בְרָעָה הָיְתָה בְּבֵיתוֹ׃
verses.english: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beri῾a, because evil had befallen his house.

verses.hebrew: וּבִתּוֹ שֶׁאֱרָה וַתִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית־חוֹרוֹן הַתַּחְתּוֹן וְאֶת־הָעֶלְיוֹן וְאֵת אֻזֵּן שֶׁאֱרָה׃
verses.english: (And his daughter was She᾽era, who built both the lower and the upper Bet-ĥoron, and Uzzen-she᾽era.)

verses.hebrew: וְרֶפַח בְּנוֹ וְרֶשֶׁף וְתֶלַח בְּנוֹ וְתַחַן בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: And Refaĥ was his son, and Reshef, and Telaĥ his son, and Taĥan his son,

verses.hebrew: לַעְדָּן בְּנוֹ עַמִּיהוּד בְּנוֹ אֱלִישָׁמָע בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: La῾dan his son, ῾Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

verses.hebrew: נוֹן בְּנוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Non his son, Yehoshua his son.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֻזָּתָם וּמֹשְׁבוֹתָם בֵּית־אֵל וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְלַמִּזְרָח נַעֲרָן וְלַמַּעֲרָב גֶּזֶר וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וּשְׁכֶם וּבְנֹתֶיהָ עַד־עַיָּה וּבְנֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: And their possessions and habitations were Bet-el and its hamlets, and eastward Na῾aran, and westward Gezer, with its hamlets; and Shekhem and its hamlets, as far as ῾Azza and its hamlets:

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יְדֵי בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה בֵּית־שְׁאָן וּבְנֹתֶיהָ תַּעְנַךְ וּבְנֹתֶיהָ מְגִדּוֹ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ דּוֹר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ בְּאֵלֶּה יָשְׁבוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and by the borders of the children of Menashshe, Bet-she᾽an and its hamlets, Ta῾nakh and its hamlets, Megiddo and its hamlets, Dor and its hamlets. In these dwelt the children of Yosef the son of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר יִמְנָה וְיִשְׁוָה וְיִשְׁוִי וּבְרִיעָה וְשֶׂרַח אֲחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: The sons of Asher; Yimna, and Yishva, and Yishvi, and Beri῾a, and Seraĥ their sister.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בְרִיעָה חֶבֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵל הוּא אֲבִי ברזות [בִרְזָיִת׃]
verses.english: And the sons of Beri῾a; Ḥever, and Malki᾽el, who is the father of Birzayit.

verses.hebrew: וְחֶבֶר הוֹלִיד אֶת־יַפְלֵט וְאֶת־שׁוֹמֵר וְאֶת־חוֹתָם וְאֵת שׁוּעָא אֲחוֹתָם׃
verses.english: And Ḥever begot Yaflet, and Shomer, and Ḥotam, and Shua their sister.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יַפְלֵט פָּסַךְ וּבִמְהָל וְעַשְׁוָת אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַפְלֵט׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yaflet; Pasakh, and Bimhal, and ῾Ashvat. These are the children of Yaflet.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שָׁמֶר אֲחִי ורוהגה [וְרָהְגָּה] יחבה [וְחֻבָּה] וַאֲרָם׃
verses.english: And the sons of Shemer; Aĥi, and Rohga, and Ḥubba, and Aram.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־הֵלֶם אָחִיו צוֹפַח וְיִמְנָע וְשֵׁלֶשׁ וְעָמָל׃
verses.english: And the sons of his brother Helem; Żofaĥ, and Yimna, and Shelesh, and ῾Amal.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי צוֹפָח סוּחַ וְחַרְנֶפֶר וְשׁוּעָל וּבֵרִי וְיִמְרָה׃
verses.english: The sons of Żofaĥ; Suaĥ, and Ḥarnefer, and Shu῾al, and Beri, and Yimra,

verses.hebrew: בֶּצֶר וָהוֹד וְשַׁמָּא וְשִׁלְשָׁה וְיִתְרָן וּבְאֵרָא׃
verses.english: Beżer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilsha, and Yitran, and Be᾽era.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יֶתֶר יְפֻנֶּה וּפִסְפָּה וַאְרָא׃
verses.english: And the sons of Yeter; Yefunne, and Pispa, and Ara.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עֻלָּא אָרַח וְחַנִּיאֵל וְרִצְיָא׃
verses.english: And the sons of ῾Ulla; Araĥ, and Ḥanni᾽el, and Riżya.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר רָאשֵׁי בֵית־הָאָבוֹת בְּרוּרִים גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים רָאשֵׁי הַנְּשִׂיאִים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם בַּצָּבָא בַּמִּלְחָמָה מִסְפָּרָם אֲנָשִׁים עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁשָּׁה אָלֶף׃
verses.english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father’s houses, choice and mighty men at arms, chiefs of the princes. And the number reckoned by genealogy of those who were apt for war and battle was twenty six thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וּבִנְיָמִן הוֹלִיד אֶת־בֶּלַע בְּכֹרוֹ אַשְׁבֵּל הַשֵּׁנִי וְאַחְרַח הַשְּׁלִישִׁי׃
verses.english: Now Binyamin begot Bela his firstborn. Ashbel the second, and Aĥraĥ the third,

verses.hebrew: נוֹחָה הָרְבִיעִי וְרָפָא הַחֲמִישִׁי׃
verses.english: Noĥa the fourth, and Rafa the fifth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בָנִים לְבָלַע אַדָּר וְגֵרָא וַאֲבִיהוּד׃
verses.english: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Avihud,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִישׁוּעַ וְנַעֲמָן וַאֲחוֹחַ׃
verses.english: and Avishua, and Na῾aman, and Aĥoaĥ,

verses.hebrew: וְגֵרָא וּשְׁפוּפָן וְחוּרָם׃
verses.english: and Gera, and Shefufan, and Ḥuram.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֵחוּד אֵלֶּה הֵם רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵי גֶבַע וַיַּגְלוּם אֶל־מָנָחַת׃
verses.english: And these are the sons of Eĥud: these are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geva, and they were exiled into Manaĥat:

verses.hebrew: וְנַעֲמָן וַאֲחִיָּה וְגֵרָא הוּא הֶגְלָם וְהוֹלִיד אֶת־עֻזָּא וְאֶת־אֲחִיחֻד׃
verses.english: and Na῾aman, and Aĥiyya, and Gera, he exiled them, and begot ῾Uzza, and Aĥiĥud.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁחֲרַיִם הוֹלִיד בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב מִן־שִׁלְחוֹ אֹתָם חוּשִׁים וְאֶת־בַּעֲרָא נָשָׁיו׃
verses.english: And Shaĥarayim begot children in the field of Mo᾽av, after he had sent away Ḥushim and Ba῾ara his wives.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹלֶד מִן־חֹדֶשׁ אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶת־יוֹבָב וְאֶת־צִבְיָא וְאֶת־מֵישָׁא וְאֶת־מַלְכָּם׃
verses.english: And he begot of Ḥodesh his wife, Yovav, and Żivya, and Mesha, and Malkam,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־יְעוּץ וְאֶת־שָׂכְיָה וְאֶת־מִרְמָה אֵלֶּה בָנָיו רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת׃
verses.english: And Ye῾uż, and Sakhya, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers’ houses.

verses.hebrew: וּמֵחֻשִׁים הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲבִיטוּב וְאֶת־אֶלְפָּעַל׃
verses.english: And of Ḥushim he begot Avituv, and Elpa῾al.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֶלְפַּעַל עֵבֶר וּמִשְׁעָם וָשָׁמֶד הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־אוֹנוֹ וְאֶת־לֹד וּבְנֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: The sons of Elpa῾al; ῾Ever, and Mish῾am, and Shemed, who built Ono, and Lod, with its hamlets:

verses.hebrew: וּבְרִעָה וָשֶׁמַע הֵמָּה רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵי אַיָּלוֹן הֵמָּה הִבְרִיחוּ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי גַת׃
verses.english: Beri῾a also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Ayyalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gat:

verses.hebrew: וְאַחְיוֹ שָׁשָׁק וִירֵמוֹת׃
verses.english: and Aĥyo, Shashaq, and Yeremot,

verses.hebrew: וּזְבַדְיָה וַעֲרָד וָעָדֶר׃
verses.english: and Zevadya, and ῾Arad, and ῾Eder,

verses.hebrew: וּמִיכָאֵל וְיִשְׁפָּה וְיוֹחָא בְּנֵי בְרִיעָה׃
verses.english: and Mikha᾽el, and Yishpa, and Yoĥa, the sons of Beri῾a;

verses.hebrew: וּזְבַדְיָה וּמְשֻׁלָּם וְחִזְקִי וָחָבֶר׃
verses.english: and Zevadya, and Meshullam, and Ḥizqi, and Ḥever,

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁמְרַי וְיִזְלִיאָה וְיוֹבָב בְּנֵי אֶלְפָּעַל׃
verses.english: and Yishmeray, and Yizli᾽a, and Yovav, the sons of Elpa῾al;

verses.hebrew: וְיָקִים וְזִכְרִי וְזַבְדִּי׃
verses.english: and Yaqim, and Zikhri, and Zavdi,

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִיעֵנַי וְצִלְּתַי וֶאֱלִיאֵל׃
verses.english: and Eli῾eenay, and Żilletay, and Eli᾽el,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲדָיָה וּבְרָאיָה וְשִׁמְרָת בְּנֵי שִׁמְעִי׃
verses.english: and ῾Adaya, and Beraya, and Shimrat, the sons of Shim῾i;

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁפָּן וָעֵבֶר וֶאֱלִיאֵל׃
verses.english: and Yishpan, and ῾Ever, and Eli᾽el,

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדּוֹן וְזִכְרִי וְחָנָן׃
verses.english: and Avdon, and Zikhri, and Ḥanan,

verses.hebrew: וַחֲנַנְיָה וְעֵילָם וְעַנְתֹתִיָּה׃
verses.english: and Ḥananya, and ῾Elam, and ῾Antotiyya,

verses.hebrew: וְיִפְדְיָה ופניאל [וּפְנוּאֵל] בְּנֵי שָׁשָׁק׃
verses.english: and Yifdeya, and Penu᾽el, the sons of Shashaq;

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁמְשְׁרַי וּשְׁחַרְיָה וַעֲתַלְיָה׃
verses.english: and Shamsheray, and Sheĥarya, and ῾Atalya,

verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲרֶשְׁיָה וְאֵלִיָּה וְזִכְרִי בְּנֵי יְרֹחָם׃
verses.english: and Ya῾areshya, and Eliyya, and Zikhri, the sons of Yeroĥam.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לְתֹלְדוֹתָם רָאשִׁים אֵלֶּה יָשְׁבוּ בִירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: These were heads of the father’s houses, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וּבְגִבְעוֹן יָשְׁבוּ אֲבִי גִבְעוֹן וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מַעֲכָה׃
verses.english: And at Giv῾on dwelt the father of Giv῾on; whose wife’s name was Ma῾akha:

verses.hebrew: וּבְנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר עַבְדּוֹן וְצוּר וְקִישׁ וּבַעַל וְנָדָב׃
verses.english: and his firstborn son ῾Avdon, and Żur, and Qish, and Ba῾al, and Nadav,

verses.hebrew: וּגְדוֹר וְאַחְיוֹ וָזָכֶר׃
verses.english: and Gedor, and Aĥyo, and Zekher.

verses.hebrew: וּמִקְלוֹת הוֹלִיד אֶת־שִׁמְאָה וְאַף־הֵמָּה נֶגֶד אֲחֵיהֶם יָשְׁבוּ בִירוּשָׁלִַם עִם־אֲחֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And Miqlot begot Shim῾a. And these also dwelt opposite their brethren in Yerushalayim, with their brethren.

verses.hebrew: וְנֵר הוֹלִיד אֶת־קִישׁ וְקִישׁ הוֹלִיד אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְשָׁאוּל הוֹלִיד אֶת־יְהוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־מַלְכִּי־שׁוּעַ וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָב וְאֶת־אֶשְׁבָּעַל׃
verses.english: And Ner begot Qish, and Qish begot Sha᾽ul, and Sha᾽ul begot Yehonatan, and Malkishua, and Avinadav, and Eshba῾al.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־יְהוֹנָתָן מְרִיב בָּעַל וּמְרִיב בַּעַל הוֹלִיד אֶת־מִיכָה׃
verses.english: And the son of Yehonatan was Meriv-ba῾al; and Meriv-ba῾al begot Mikha.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מִיכָה פִּיתוֹן וָמֶלֶךְ וְתַאְרֵעַ וְאָחָז׃
verses.english: And the sons of Mikha were, Piton, and Melekh, and Ta᾽rea, and Aĥaz.

verses.hebrew: וְאָחָז הוֹלִיד אֶת־יְהוֹעַדָּה וִיהוֹעַדָּה הוֹלִיד אֶת־עָלֶמֶת וְאֶת־עַזְמָוֶת וְאֶת־זִמְרִי וְזִמְרִי הוֹלִיד אֶת־מוֹצָא׃
verses.english: And Aĥaz begot Yeho῾adda; and Yeho῾adda begot ῾Alemet, and ῾Azmavet, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moża,

verses.hebrew: וּמוֹצָא הוֹלִיד אֶת־בִּנְעָא רָפָה בְנוֹ אֶלְעָשָׂה בְנוֹ אָצֵל בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: and Moża begot Bin῾a: Rafa was his son, El῾asa his son, Ażel his son:

verses.hebrew: וּלְאָצֵל שִׁשָּׁה בָנִים וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם עַזְרִיקָם בֹּכְרוּ וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל וּשְׁעַרְיָה וְעֹבַדְיָה וְחָנָן כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אָצַל׃
verses.english: and Ażel had six sons, whose names are these, ῾Azriqam, Bokheru, and Yishma᾽el, and She῾arya, and ῾Ovadya, and Ḥanan. All these were the sons of Ażel.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עֵשֶׁק אָחִיו אוּלָם בְּכֹרוֹ יְעוּשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וֶאֱלִיפֶלֶט הַשְּׁלִשִׁי׃
verses.english: And the sons of ῾Eseq his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Ye῾ush the second, and Elifelet the third.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־אוּלָם אֲנָשִׁים גִּבֹּרֵי־חַיִל דֹּרְכֵי קֶשֶׁת וּמַרְבִּים בָּנִים וּבְנֵי בָנִים מֵאָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים כָּל־אֵלֶּה מִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן׃
verses.english: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men at arms, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Binyamin.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְיַחְשׂוּ וְהִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה הָגְלוּ לְבָבֶל בְּמַעֲלָם׃
verses.english: So all Yisra᾽el were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Yisra᾽el; and Yehuda was carried away to Bavel for their transgression.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר בַּאֲחֻזָּתָם בְּעָרֵיהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְהַנְּתִינִים׃
verses.english: Now the first inhabitants who dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Yisra᾽elites, the priests, Levites, and the temple servants.

verses.hebrew: וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם יָשְׁבוּ מִן־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִן־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וּמִן־בְּנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: And in Yerushalayim dwelt some of the children of Yehuda, and some of the children of Binyamin, and some of the children of Efrayim, and Menashshe;

verses.hebrew: עוּתַי בֶּן־עַמִּיהוּד בֶּן־עָמְרִי בֶּן־אִמְרִי בֶן־בנימן־[בָּנִי] [מִן־] בְּנֵי־פֶרֶץ בֶּן־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: ῾Utay the son of ῾Ammihud, the son of ῾Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pereż the son of Yehuda.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַשִּׁילוֹנִי עֲשָׂיָה הַבְּכוֹר וּבָנָיו׃
verses.english: And of the Shiloni; ῾Asaya the firstborn, and his sons.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־בְּנֵי־זֶרַח יְעוּאֵל וַאֲחֵיהֶם שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְתִשְׁעִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Zeraĥ; Ye῾u᾽el, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־בְּנֵי בִּנְיָמִן סַלּוּא בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־הוֹדַוְיָה בֶּן־הַסְּנֻאָה׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Binyamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodavya, the son of Senu᾽a,

verses.hebrew: וְיִבְנְיָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם וְאֵלָה בֶן־עֻזִּי בֶּן־מִכְרִי וּמְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־שְׁפַטְיָה בֶּן־רְעוּאֵל בֶּן־יִבְנִיָּה׃
verses.english: and Yivneya the son of Yeroĥam, and Ela the son of ῾Uzzi, the son of Mikhri, and Meshullam the son of Shefatya, the son of Re῾u᾽el, the son of Yivniyya;

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֵיהֶם לְתֹלְדוֹתָם תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה כָּל־אֵלֶּה אֲנָשִׁים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לְבֵית אֲבֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty six. All these men were chiefs of the fathers in the houses of their fathers.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַכֹּהֲנִים יְדַעְיָה וִיהוֹיָרִיב וְיָכִין׃
verses.english: And of the priests; Yeda῾ya, and Yehoyariv, and Yakhin,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲזַרְיָה בֶן־חִלְקִיָּה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־צָדוֹק בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב נְגִיד בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: and ῾Azarya the son of Ḥilqiyya, the son of Meshullam, the son of Żadoq, the son of Merayot, the son of Aĥituv, the ruler of the house of God;

verses.hebrew: וַעֲדָיָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם בֶּן־פַּשְׁחוּר בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּה וּמַעְשַׂי בֶּן־עֲדִיאֵל בֶּן־יַחְזֵרָה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־מְשִׁלֵּמִית בֶּן־אִמֵּר׃
verses.english: and ῾Adaya the son of Yeroĥam, the son of Pashĥur, the son of Malkiyya, and Ma῾asay the son of ῾Adi᾽el, the son of Yaĥzera, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemit, the son of Immer;

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֵיהֶם רָאשִׁים לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים גִּבּוֹרֵי חֵיל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: and their brethren, heads of the houses of their fathers, a thousand seven hundred and sixty; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּם שְׁמַעְיָה בֶן־חַשּׁוּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָה מִן־בְּנֵי מְרָרִי׃
verses.english: And of the Levites; Shema῾ya the son of Ḥashshuv, the son of ῾Azriqam, the son of Ḥashavya, of the sons of Merari;

verses.hebrew: וּבַקְבַּקַּר חֶרֶשׁ וְגָלָל וּמַתַּנְיָה בֶּן־מִיכָא בֶּן־זִכְרִי בֶּן־אָסָף׃
verses.english: and Baqbaqqar, Ḥeresh, and Galal, and Mattanya the son of Mikha, the son of Zikhri, the son of Asaf;

verses.hebrew: וְעֹבַדְיָה בֶּן־שְׁמַעְיָה בֶּן־גָּלָל בֶּן־יְדוּתוּן וּבֶרֶכְיָה בֶן־אָסָא בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחַצְרֵי נְטוֹפָתִי׃
verses.english: and ῾Ovadya the son of Shema῾ya, the son of Galal, the son of Yedutun, and Berekhya the son of Asa, the son of Elqana, who dwelt in the settlements of the Netofati.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים שַׁלּוּם וְעַקּוּב וְטַלְמֹן וַאֲחִימָן וַאֲחִיהֶם שַׁלּוּם הָרֹאשׁ׃
verses.english: And the gatekeepers were; Shallum, and ῾Aqquv, and Talmon, and Aĥiman, and their brethren: (Shallum being the chief;)

verses.hebrew: וְעַד־הֵנָּה בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ מִזְרָחָה הֵמָּה הַשֹּׁעֲרִים לְמַחֲנוֹת בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃
verses.english: who were hitherto stationed at the king’s gate eastward; they were gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁלּוּם בֶּן־קוֹרֵא בֶּן־אֶבְיָסָף בֶּן־קֹרַח וְאֶחָיו לְבֵית־אָבִיו הַקָּרְחִים עַל מְלֶאכֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה שֹׁמְרֵי הַסִּפִּים לָאֹהֶל וַאֲבֹתֵיהֶם עַל־מַחֲנֵה יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֵי הַמָּבוֹא׃
verses.english: And Shallum the son of Qore, the son of Evyasaf, the son of Qoraĥ, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Qorĥim, were over the work of the service, keepers of the threshold of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the camp of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.

verses.hebrew: וּפִינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר נָגִיד הָיָה עֲלֵיהֶם לְפָנִים יְהוָה עִמּוֹ׃
